The workday calendar keys calendar.cn_holidays.<year> and calendar.cn_makeup_workdays.<year> for 2026–2030 (ten literal keys) are registered in the content config registry (object, config.general, admin-editable, not seeded) with per-item validation (array of real YYYY-MM-DD dates of the key's year, no duplicates, empty allowed; otherwise 20001). Readers: both same-year keys come from one batch statement (configValues) in the withdrawal review deadline, the appeal deadline, the deletion expiry scan and the admin data copies, and the production wiring passes the batch port (admin appeal registration included). A deadline crossing into a year not yet read re-reads all its years in one statement and recomputes from that result alone; when that re-read fails the last successfully read whole set is kept and the unread years count weekends only with the unconfigured warning; two reads are never combined. No contract, no migration.
